summary: Tested saved size charts per account + 'photo once' in CalcolaTagliaBox. All requested flows PASS. fam_test: calcola-last-photo-text 'Usiamo la tua ultima foto intera (del 16/10)'; CTA with only URL -> only POST /api/product/analyze (no auto-measure, no toast). Zara giacca URL -> calcola-fallback; PIL PNG chart uploaded -> result size S; mongo saved_size_charts doc {account_id fam-owner-1791784817, brand_key 'zara', group 'sopra', host_keys ['zara'], size_chart S/M/L}. Zara maglia URL -> calcola-result with calcola-saved-chart-text 'Tabella Zara salvata dal tuo screenshot'; calcola-new-screenshot-btn shows calcola-fallback. Cambia foto -> file chooser -> calcola-photo-selected -> CTA calls POST /api/profile/auto-measure then /api/product/analyze (analyze mocked to save LLM); photo_measured_at updated. New user without measurements: calcola-photo-btn shown, toast 'Carica una tua foto intera', no API calls. Backend: analyze-text saves chart for its account; in-process checks: other account's chart not used, amazon URL returns None even with host_keys ['amazon'] doc. Regression: 'Niente metro' present, /studio and /profile load. ~6 LLM calls used.

minor.issue: Only strips www/www2/shop/it/... prefixes. Hosts like m.zalando.it -> 'm', mobile/en/store subdomains give generic keys; a host_key 'm' saved from m.brandA.com would match any m.brandB.com link (wrong brand chart). Use registrable domain label (second-level) instead of first label.

_analyze_with_saved_chart called without category -> returns the most recent chart of ANY group (e.g., a saved 'scarpe' chart could be used for a jacket). Consider inferring group from URL/keywords or preferring 'sopra'/asking.

Zara returns HTTP 200 bot page (2.2KB), so 'blocked' path is not hit; each analyze costs 2 LLM calls (page + saved chart). Consider checking saved chart first when condensed page is tiny/has no size table. Also the saved-chart result in the blocked branch is not logged to product_analyses.

issues: Help text 'Carica una tua foto intera e incolla il link...' still shown when the last photo is reused; could say just 'Incolla il link'.
After a new photo is measured, photo state is not cleared, so each subsequent CTA re-uploads and re-measures the photo (minor).
